newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish guards end Croat mutiny on Russian ship.
newsitem.headline: Turkish guards end Croat mutiny on Russian ship.

text.p: Turkey's coast guards quashed a mutiny on a Russian ship in its waters on Saturday, seizing 14 rebel Croat crew and freeing the captain and other crew members from imprisonment in a cabin, the Anatolian news agency said.

Turkish border security guards were informed overnight that the freighter Ivan Chernykh had been hijacked following its departure from a Bulgarian port, and they forced it to drop anchor off the Turkish Black Sea coast, the state-run news agency said.
The guards performed the rescue operation early on Saturday without meeting any opposition from the mutineers, the agency said.
It was not immediately clear why there had been a mutiny on the ship.
Coast guard officials told Anatolian that marine police would begin an inquiry into the incident.
The 14 Croatians would eventually be sent back to their country. The captain had requested a fresh crew from Russia, the agency said.
The dry cargo ship had been heading to the Spanish port of Seville.
